package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG commits answer state and action events atomically.
type LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (repo LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG) CreateAnswer(
	ctx context.Context,
	answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer,
	maxAttempts *int,
	action domain.StudentLearningAction,
) (domain.StudentTaskAnswer, domain.StudentLearningAction, error) {
	if repo.Pool == nil || action.StudentTaskAnswerID != answer.ID || action.StudentID != answer.StudentID || action.TaskID != answer.TaskID {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.StudentLearningAction{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if !domain.IsLearningEvidenceClass(action.EvidenceClass) {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.StudentLearningAction{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	targets, err := json.Marshal(action.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	tx, err := repo.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	if err := validateLessonAssessmentStartTx(ctx, tx, answer); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	if answer.LearningPathItemID != "" {
		if err := activateLessonItemTx(ctx, tx, answer.StudentID, answer.LearningPathItemID, answer.StartedAt); err != nil {
			return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
		}
	}

	err = tx.QueryRow(ctx, `
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempt), 0) AS last_attempt, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM student_task_answer
    WHERE task_id = $1 AND student_id = $2
 AND learning_path_item_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF($14, '')::uuid
 AND requirement_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF($15, '')::uuid
), inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO student_task_answer (
        id, student_id, task_id, filestorage_id, answer_payload,
        started_at, ended_at, status, attempt, created_at, updated_at, learning_path_item_id, requirement_id, frozen_task_json
    )
    SELECT $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10, stats.last_attempt + 1, $11, $12, NULLIF($14, '')::uuid, NULLIF($15, '')::uuid, $16::jsonb
    FROM stats
    WHERE $13::int IS NULL OR stats.count < $13
    RETURNING attempt
)
SELECT attempt FROM inserted
`,
		answer.TaskID,
		answer.StudentID,
		answer.ID,
		answer.StudentID,
		answer.TaskID,
		answer.FilestorageID,
		answer.AnswerPayload,
		answer.StartedAt,
		answer.EndedAt,
		answer.Status,
		answer.CreatedAt,
		answer.UpdatedAt,
		maxAttempts, answer.LearningPathItemID, answer.RequirementID, answer.FrozenTaskJSON,
	).Scan(&answer.Attempt)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.StudentLearningAction{}, domain.ErrMaxAttempts
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	action.Cycle = 1
	if err := insertLearningAction(ctx, tx, action, targets); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	return answer, action, nil
}

func (repo LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG) EnsureActive(ctx context.Context, action domain.StudentLearningAction) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error) {
	if repo.Pool == nil || !domain.IsLearningEvidenceClass(action.EvidenceClass) {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	active, err := repo.GetActiveByAnswer(ctx, action.StudentTaskAnswerID)
	if err == nil {
		return active, nil
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	targets, err := json.Marshal(action.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	tx, err := repo.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	answer, err := guardCourseActionOpeningTx(ctx, tx, domain.StudentTaskAnswer{ID: action.StudentTaskAnswerID, StudentID: action.StudentID, TaskID: action.TaskID})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	if answer.LearningPathItemID != "" {
		if err := activateLessonItemTx(ctx, tx, answer.StudentID, answer.LearningPathItemID, action.OpenedAt); err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
		}
	}
	err = tx.QueryRow(ctx, `
INSERT INTO student_learning_action (
    id, student_task_answer_id, student_id, task_id, cycle,
    context_type, context_id, learning_targets, evidence_class, opened_at, created_at, learning_path_item_id, requirement_id
)
SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, COALESCE(MAX(cycle), 0) + 1, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8, $9, $9,
 (SELECT learning_path_item_id FROM student_task_answer WHERE id=$2),
 (SELECT requirement_id FROM student_task_answer WHERE id=$2)
FROM student_learning_action
WHERE student_task_answer_id = $2
RETURNING cycle
`, action.ID, action.StudentTaskAnswerID, action.StudentID, action.TaskID, action.ContextType, action.ContextID, string(targets), action.EvidenceClass, action.OpenedAt).Scan(&action.Cycle)
	if err == nil {
		if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
		}
		return action, nil
	}
	_ = tx.Rollback(ctx)
	if active, activeErr := repo.GetActiveByAnswer(ctx, action.StudentTaskAnswerID); activeErr == nil {
		return active, nil
	}
	return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
}

func (repo LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG) GetActiveByAnswer(ctx context.Context, answerID string) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error) {
	if repo.Pool == nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return scanLearningAction(repo.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT id, student_task_answer_id, student_id, task_id, cycle, context_type,
       context_id, learning_targets, evidence_class, outcome,
       outcome_policy_version, opened_at, closed_at
FROM student_learning_action
WHERE student_task_answer_id = $1 AND closed_at IS NULL
`, answerID))
}

// GetByStudentAndID enforces action ownership in the database lookup so a
// missing and a foreign action have the same not-found result.
func (repo LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG) GetByStudentAndID(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	learningActionID string,
) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error) {
	if repo.Pool == nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return scanLearningAction(repo.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT id, student_task_answer_id, student_id, task_id, cycle, context_type,
       context_id, learning_targets, evidence_class, outcome,
       outcome_policy_version, opened_at, closed_at
FROM student_learning_action
WHERE id = $1 AND student_id = $2 AND source_kind = 'course_answer'
`, learningActionID, studentID))
}

func (repo LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG) ReopenAnswer(
	ctx context.Context,
	answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer,
	action domain.StudentLearningAction,
) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error) {
	if repo.Pool == nil || action.StudentTaskAnswerID != answer.ID || action.StudentID != answer.StudentID || action.TaskID != answer.TaskID {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if !domain.IsLearningEvidenceClass(action.EvidenceClass) {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	targets, err := json.Marshal(action.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	tx, err := repo.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	answer, err = guardCourseActionOpeningTx(ctx, tx, answer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	if answer.LearningPathItemID != "" {
		if err := activateLessonItemTx(ctx, tx, answer.StudentID, answer.LearningPathItemID, action.OpenedAt); err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
		}
	}
	if err := updateAnswer(ctx, tx, answer); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	err = tx.QueryRow(ctx, `
INSERT INTO student_learning_action (
    id, student_task_answer_id, student_id, task_id, cycle,
    context_type, context_id, learning_targets, evidence_class, opened_at, created_at, learning_path_item_id, requirement_id
)
SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, COALESCE(MAX(cycle), 0) + 1, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8, $9, $9,
 (SELECT learning_path_item_id FROM student_task_answer WHERE id=$2),
 (SELECT requirement_id FROM student_task_answer WHERE id=$2)
FROM student_learning_action
WHERE student_task_answer_id = $2
RETURNING cycle
`, action.ID, action.StudentTaskAnswerID, action.StudentID, action.TaskID, action.ContextType, action.ContextID, string(targets), action.EvidenceClass, action.OpenedAt).Scan(&action.Cycle)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	return action, nil
}

func (repo LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG) CloseAnswer(
	ctx context.Context,
	answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer,
	action domain.StudentLearningAction,
	event domain.IntegrationEvent,
) error {
	if repo.Pool == nil || action.StudentTaskAnswerID != answer.ID || event.Subject != domain.SubjectLearningActionClosed ||
		event.CorrelationID != action.ID || event.CausationID != answer.ID || event.StudentID != answer.StudentID ||
		action.OutcomePolicyVersion != domain.MasteryPolicyVersion {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	expectedOutcome, err := domain.LearningActionOutcomeForAnswerStatus(answer.Status)
	if err != nil || !domain.IsLearningActionOutcome(action.Outcome) || action.Outcome != expectedOutcome {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	tx, err := repo.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	// All action writers acquire the planning fence before action/answer rows.
	// PASSED closure applies a fact under this same fence; acquiring it late
	// would invert the ordering against a concurrent new/reopened cycle.
	if err := lockStudentAdmissionFence(ctx, tx, answer.StudentID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	command, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE student_learning_action
SET closed_at = $2, outcome = $4, outcome_policy_version = $5
WHERE id = $1 AND student_task_answer_id = $3 AND closed_at IS NULL
`, action.ID, event.OccurredAt, answer.ID, action.Outcome, action.OutcomePolicyVersion)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return domain.ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if err := updateAnswer(ctx, tx, answer); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if answer.Status == domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed {
		// Correlation and scoring snapshot are immutable persisted attempt identity.
		var itemID, requirementID string
		var frozen json.RawMessage
		if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COALESCE(learning_path_item_id::text,''), COALESCE(requirement_id::text,''), frozen_task_json FROM student_task_answer WHERE id=$1 AND student_id=$2 AND task_id=$3 FOR UPDATE`, answer.ID, answer.StudentID, answer.TaskID).Scan(&itemID, &requirementID, &frozen); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if itemID != "" || requirementID != "" {
			var snapshot struct {
				ID         string `json:"id"`
				Type       string `json:"_completion_fact_type"`
				RevisionID string `json:"_completion_source_revision_id"`
			}
			if json.Unmarshal(frozen, &snapshot) != nil || snapshot.ID != answer.TaskID || itemID == "" || requirementID == "" || (snapshot.Type != "quiz_passed" && snapshot.Type != "task_passed") {
				return domain.ErrValidation
			}
			if _, _, err := applyLessonFactTx(ctx, tx, domain.LessonActivityFact{StudentID: answer.StudentID, ItemID: itemID, RequirementID: requirementID, Type: snapshot.Type, SourceID: answer.TaskID, SourceRevisionID: snapshot.RevisionID, FactID: answer.ID, OccurredAt: event.OccurredAt}); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}
	_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO student_outbox (
    event_id, subject, schema_version, student_id, correlation_id,
    causation_id, occurred_at, payload, next_attempt_at, created_at
) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NULLIF($6, ''), $7, $8::jsonb, $7, $7)
`, event.EventID, event.Subject, event.SchemaVersion, event.StudentID, event.CorrelationID, event.CausationID, event.OccurredAt, string(event.Payload))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}

func insertLearningAction(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, action domain.StudentLearningAction, targets []byte) error {
	_, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO student_learning_action (
    id, student_task_answer_id, student_id, task_id, cycle,
    context_type, context_id, learning_targets, evidence_class, opened_at, created_at, learning_path_item_id, requirement_id
) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, $9, $10, $10,
 (SELECT learning_path_item_id FROM student_task_answer WHERE id=$2),
 (SELECT requirement_id FROM student_task_answer WHERE id=$2))
`, action.ID, action.StudentTaskAnswerID, action.StudentID, action.TaskID, action.Cycle, action.ContextType, action.ContextID, string(targets), action.EvidenceClass, action.OpenedAt)
	return err
}

func updateAnswer(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer) error {
	_, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE student_task_answer
SET filestorage_id = $1, answer_payload = $2, ended_at = $3,
    status = $4, attempt = $5, updated_at = $6
WHERE id = $7
`, answer.FilestorageID, answer.AnswerPayload, answer.EndedAt, answer.Status, answer.Attempt, answer.UpdatedAt, answer.ID)
	return err
}

type learningActionRow interface {
	Scan(dest ...any) error
}

func scanLearningAction(row learningActionRow) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error) {
	var action domain.StudentLearningAction
	var targets json.RawMessage
	var evidenceClass, outcome, outcomePolicyVersion sql.NullString
	if err := row.Scan(
		&action.ID,
		&action.StudentTaskAnswerID,
		&action.StudentID,
		&action.TaskID,
		&action.Cycle,
		&action.ContextType,
		&action.ContextID,
		&targets,
		&evidenceClass,
		&outcome,
		&outcomePolicyVersion,
		&action.OpenedAt,
		&action.ClosedAt,
	); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
			return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(targets, &action.LearningTargets); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	if evidenceClass.Valid {
		action.EvidenceClass = domain.LearningEvidenceClass(evidenceClass.String)
	}
	if outcome.Valid {
		action.Outcome = domain.LearningActionOutcome(outcome.String)
	}
	if outcomePolicyVersion.Valid {
		action.OutcomePolicyVersion = outcomePolicyVersion.String
	}
	return action, nil
}

var _ repository.LearningActionLifecycleRepository = (*LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG)(nil)
var _ repository.LearningActionReader = (*LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG)(nil)

// Serialize correlated starts with path facts/replans and recheck frozen membership
// after acquiring the lock, so stale reads cannot start a removed assignment.
func validateLessonAssessmentStartTx(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer) error {
	if answer.LearningPathItemID == "" && answer.RequirementID == "" {
		return nil
	}
	if answer.LearningPathItemID == "" || answer.RequirementID == "" {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1,0))`, "learning-path:"+answer.StudentID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var pathStatus, itemStatus string
	var requirements json.RawMessage
	err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT p.status,i.status,i.frozen_requirements FROM student_learning_path_item i JOIN student_learning_path p ON p.id=i.student_learning_path_id WHERE i.id=$1 AND p.student_id=$2 FOR UPDATE OF p,i`, answer.LearningPathItemID, answer.StudentID).Scan(&pathStatus, &itemStatus, &requirements)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if (pathStatus != string(domain.LearningPathStatusActive) && pathStatus != string(domain.LearningPathStatusPaused)) || itemStatus == string(domain.LearningPathItemCompleted) || itemStatus == string(domain.LearningPathItemSkippedMastered) {
		return domain.ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if _, err := validateLessonCommandAdmissionTx(ctx, tx, answer.StudentID, answer.LearningPathItemID, answer.RequirementID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var list []domain.LessonRequirement
	var snapshot struct {
		ID         string `json:"id"`
		Type       string `json:"_completion_fact_type"`
		RevisionID string `json:"_completion_source_revision_id"`
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(requirements, &list) != nil || json.Unmarshal(answer.FrozenTaskJSON, &snapshot) != nil || snapshot.ID != answer.TaskID {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	for _, r := range list {
		if r.ID != answer.RequirementID {
			continue
		}
		if r.Satisfied || r.SourceReference.ID != answer.TaskID || r.Type != snapshot.Type || r.SourceReference.RevisionID != snapshot.RevisionID || (r.Type != "quiz_passed" && r.Type != "task_passed") {
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return nil
	}
	return domain.ErrNotFound
}

// Opening/reopening must serialize with planning before loading the immutable
// persisted assignment. A stale pre-transaction answer cannot recreate an OPEN
// action after planning removed its item or changed its admissibility.
func guardCourseActionOpeningTx(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer) (domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	if err := lockStudentAdmissionFence(ctx, tx, answer.StudentID); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, err
	}
	err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COALESCE(learning_path_item_id::text,''),COALESCE(requirement_id::text,''),frozen_task_json
 FROM student_task_answer WHERE id=$1 AND student_id=$2 AND task_id=$3 FOR UPDATE`, answer.ID, answer.StudentID, answer.TaskID).Scan(&answer.LearningPathItemID, &answer.RequirementID, &answer.FrozenTaskJSON)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, err
	}
	if err := validateLessonAssessmentStartTx(ctx, tx, answer); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, err
	}
	return answer, nil
}
